sensor_noise_scale: outer-training resampled per-channel population std; float64 over all finite 512-position training values
stuck_value: outer-training per-channel median; first six force/torque channels only
sensor_domain: raw in-segment samples, then exact frozen resample_progress and statistics; timestamp arrays unchanged
quality: same 36 frozen fields recomputed on corrupted images/raw sensor samples with original formulas; unchanged-modality fields reused; train scalers unchanged
thresholds: frozen clean model thresholds for all conditions; complete fusion modality loss adopts remaining unimodal branch threshold
missing_unimodal: unavailable unimodal sensor/visual model abstains; metrics null rather than fabricated chance predictions
missing_fusion: all fusion probabilities equal remaining calibrated branch probability; F1/F2 renormalization convention bypasses learned intercept when only one branch available; gates masked exactly
mechanism: ordered severity Spearman (descriptive, repeated segments not independent); paired recording CI for degraded-modality weight shift; both expected direction and outcome required
positive_claim: For a family/gate: high-severity mean degraded-weight shift upper95<0 and negative Spearman; paired AP degradation advantage lower95>0 and AUROC degradation advantage lower95>-0.01. Marginal intervals; family-specific exploratory claims only. Require high-severity absolute AP difference vs F2 lower95>0 for an absolute superiority claim. No selection/tuning from these outcomes.

dropout.fallback: F5 only if structural correctness fails without invalidating pipeline
dropout.architecture_settings: reuse each fold Section 2 clean-selected F6 config; no new hyperparameter search; frozen branch inner probabilities, same normalization/loss, re-estimate threshold only on frozen inner OOF training folds

optional_combined: not planned; single-modality suite answers mechanism question without further exploration
visual_noise: float32 BGR pixels /255 after decoding, Gaussian noise then clip [0,1], round*255 to uint8, before RT-DETR preprocessing; independent seeded draws per original frame index
visual_blur: OpenCV GaussianBlur sigmaX=sigmaY, kernel 2*ceil(3*sigma)+1, BORDER_REFLECT_101, native resolution before preprocessing
frame_dropout: drop round(16*fraction): 2/5/8 frames using seeded permutation; omit dropped frames, pool retained clean per-frame embeddings; quality valid/failed ratios reference original 16 requested frames
channel_dropout: drop round(22*fraction): 2/7/11 channels without replacement, NaN raw interval values, retain timestamps; whole-stream quality recalculated
temporal_dropout: one contiguous normalized-progress block of specified fractional length; start uniform in [0,1-fraction], all sensor channels; NaN samples in block; no extrapolation across gap
seed_derivation: SHA256 first 8 bytes little-endian of global_seed|recording_id|segment_id|family|severity; visual noise additionally original frame index; no labels
